page.notes: The right margin has small reference marks near "fan-" and "dicit" (a star-like mark and a fleuron); they are not clearly legible, so I did not transcribe them as notes. The left-margin word beside "2." is set in bold italic and is uncertain; read as "Antipelk." with [?]. The line "35, 36, 37." was read as a continuation of the Jeremiah reference. The printed word "fan-" with the long s and the "ćte" mark were read with some doubt.
